issues.reason: Measures & units defines (Measure <entity> <scale> <magnitude> <unit>) as putting a number on a dimension OF that entity, so (Measure sk_lower_1 risk 88 percent) asserts the falsehood that the lowering event has a risk of 88 percent, when 88 percent is the extent of the reduction.

The observation stands — the modality is unrepresented — but the defect claim does not: no status operator covers hypothetical / future-in-past 'would' (Counterfactual requires the subjunctive had / would-have form), and the omission leaves no false atom inside a complement that is sealed and therefore asserted nowhere.

gaps_confirmed: 'V by N percent' — a percentage extent-of-change on an event has no licensed carrier (Measure is a dimension of an entity, MoreBy a two-entity comparative, Fraction a partitive level)
hypothetical / future-in-past 'would' is absent from the status-predicate inventory
new_gaps: a gerund clause as the subject of a transitive ('Taking the pill would lower the risk') — the role sections assume entity fillers and never state how an eventuality fills Agent

a fixed non-compositional noun-noun term ('heart attack') — the compound-kind rule says the genus is 'always emitted', while the idiom rule says do not decompose non-compositional compounds; nothing resolves which governs
repair_summary: Removed (Measure sk_lower_1 risk 88 percent) and (Measure sk_lower_2 risk 80 percent) from the sealed complement; no licensed head records an extent of change, so the offending content is dropped rather than re-encoded (gap recorded).
notes: Everything else is left untouched: the non-factive seal under Theme, the projected definite pill/risk typings, the expanded gapped second conjunct, and the entity-attached (Of ...) obliques are all licensed.
